provenance.date_time_convention: source local clock represented as UTC for deterministic ordering
provenance.evidence_metric: complete annotated utterance text and original source span
provenance.indexing: one dialogue utterance per canonical user-role turn; speaker prefix; text only

model.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling followed by L2 normalization

reference.control_scope: Original RRF function inside the shared candidate runtime; not a separate whole-runtime comparison.

interpretation: Old development/regression cohorts; evidence retrieval only. Both semantic routes share the candidate runtime/index. No answer generation or new-domain generalization claim.

methodology.execution: All three modes execute for every query/configuration/repetition. Rotate mode order by query position plus repetition. Retain deterministic seed+1009*repetition query permutation, committed attempt intents, failure records, source/model/configuration identities and all repeated timings. Index and model preparation are outside query latency but reported separately. Do not overlap timed measurements with other CPU benchmarks on this host.
methodology.external_validation: A separate agent freezes and owns a new 256-question HotpotQA sample excluding the old 128. This agent must not inspect its questions or per-query results. Freeze the selected candidate source and parameters before one external evaluation; do not tune on that result or replay it to select a better score.

frozen_policy.cache_identity: Compatibility amendment before development scoring: retain SEMANTIC_VERSION=1 and the exact old model/index fingerprint; introduce FUSION_VERSION=2 only in semantic recall cache keys. Existing semantic indexes are reused without recomputing identical embeddings, while old fusion result caches are not reused.
frozen_policy.empty_lexical_route: Preserve the original semantic order and legacy single-route reciprocal-rank scores.
frozen_policy.empty_semantic_route: Preserve the original lexical order and scores.
frozen_policy.invalid_scores: Reject non-finite scores and duplicate identities within either route instead of assigning confidence to malformed candidates.
frozen_policy.lexical_score: max(original lexical score, 0) divided by the maximum nonnegative lexical score; zero when every score is zero
frozen_policy.scope: Fusion only. No new query decomposition, prompt, learned gate, source rewrite, model call, candidate expansion or packing policy. Existing lexical novelty/current/coverage ordering may still be affected by fusion; report the measured outcome.
frozen_policy.semantic_score: (cosine - minimum returned cosine) / (maximum returned cosine - minimum returned cosine); zero when the range is zero

methodology.interpretation: Old synthetic, authored, public and Hotpot128 questions are development/regression evidence. Source retrieval metrics do not establish answer correctness, general semantic memory or a whole-product ranking. No fixed case IDs, answers, annotations or gold evidence may enter runtime rules.
methodology.legacy_reference: Use the exact original fuse_candidates function body from the baseline semantic.py with RRF_K=60; verify the function body against the baseline Git object before scoring. Both semantic modes share the same verified vectors and source archive.

model.query_inference: One existing encode_query operation for each explicitly semantic recall; no model use on lexical calls.

methodology.purpose: Isolate the effect of retaining lexical and semantic score margins; do not attribute every semantic failure to rank fusion or change the default lexical path.
required_outputs: all per-query annotation and complete-evidence gains/losses
context tokens and returned payload tokens
methodology.selection_rule: No weight grid or post-result threshold tuning in Q1. Publish every old development/regression cohort and budget, including negative results. Keep semantic=false as the product default. If Q1 quality is unstable, it may be rejected rather than presented as a general improvement.

model.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling followed by L2 normalization
